studies.title: The ocean-going junk
studies.caption: Song shipyards build large seagoing junks with watertight bulkheads, several masts and battened sails.
studies.prompt: View inside a Song shipyard near Quanzhou about1150CE over an unfinished wooden hull, several transverse bulkhead partitions dividing its interior visibly; shipwrights fitting planks, a completed batten-sailed junk in distant harbor. No massive Ming treasure ship, no metal welding.
